name: P24 walk out of Puddlewick after Papa (no teleport onto pad)

steps.note: B2 already done — stand on the gate lane north of the exit and walk south

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const w=Field.world();const lane=(w.map.exits||[]).find(e=>e.to==='meadow');window.__LANE=lane&&{x:lane.x,z:lane.z,w:lane.w,h:lane.h};const m=w.map;const solids=[];for(let z=23;z<=29;z+=0.5){const x=15.5;const t=m.tileAt(x,z);solids.push({x,z,solid:!!(t&&t.solid)});}window.__SOLIDS=solids;__DQ.face(0);try{__DQ.cameraOrbit(180);}catch(_){ }await sleep(200);for(let i=0;i<10&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';i++){__DQ.hold('up',900);await sleep(1100);}return JSON.stringify({map:__DQ.state().map.id,player:__DQ.state().player&&{x:+__DQ.state().player.x.toFixed(2),z:+__DQ.state().player.z.toFixed(2),blocked:__DQ.state().player.blocked},lane:window.__LANE,solids:window.__SOLIDS});})()

steps.msg: walking south from the gate reaches the meadow

steps.note: Walk south on the meadow to the Long Lane signpost — B3 must arm, not bounce

steps.msg: Long Lane signpost starts B3 (Bobble), not a dead-end bounce
